explanations.text:
# CREATE FEEDBACK SESSION JSON
in s3 [create a sessions.json file at /](create)
if sessions.json file already exists on feedback/sessions.json, then upload it.
elif sessions.json already exist on s3, return.
else then create empty file.


# GET FEEDBACK SESSION JSON
[get sessions.json file from s3](get)
if exists, print contents


# GET FEEDBACK NOT IMPLEMENTED YET.
this isn't the code from lambda/ 

sessions = read sessions.json in s3
[query the s3 to bring over all the sessions from all users using index.json](indexes)
[merge the returned values with sessions](pending), include id, analyzed (true or false) and which user comes from, 
  skip if:
    session id already exists
    session is open
print the merged result


# MARK FEEDBACK AS IMPLEMENTED
input = list of session ids
sessions = get sessions.json file from s3
[for each session id from input mark analyzed to true in sessions](mark)
update the session.json in s3
